description: Single master SVG, all exports derived from it. A solid-fill shield mark (no strokes) so the design has no thin line that can vanish at 16px — the constraint 'minimum line weight 4px' is satisfied by construction rather than by hitting an exact stroke-width number.

designRules.minLineWeightNote: No stroked lines are used anywhere in this mark; every shape is a solid fill, so there is no line to fall below 4px. The center dot (the smallest positive shape) still renders as a distinct ~5px feature at the smallest 16px export.

geometry.source: 05-Icons/brand/logo-mark.svg (64x64), rescaled to fill the 512 canvas's 12% safe area

exports.note: solid bg (#0F172A) per Apple's own guidance — iOS composites transparency to black otherwise, and applies its own corner mask
pure #000000 silhouette, no background — Safari recolors via <link rel="mask-icon" color="...">
identical content to mask-icon.svg; shipped under both conventional filenames since site generators vary on which one they look for

exportPipeline.renderer: headless WebKit (wkhtmltoimage) with a magenta chroma-key background, alpha extracted in post (no native transparent-render mode was available), then Lanczos-downsampled from the 512 base to every raster size
exportPipeline.note: wkhtmltoimage always composites onto an opaque page background and has no transparency flag in this environment; true alpha was recovered by rendering on a #FF00FF background no other color in this mark is close to, then converting distance-from-key into a per-pixel alpha channel.
